sun_application_statement.revision_note: After the FT norm-exponent proof repair, the theorem statement was reread and its unchanged application scope reaffirmed. The new proof is separately reviewed.

entries.statement: For K=Q(sqrt(2)), d=3-sqrt(2), D=d^2=11-6sqrt(2), E:y^2=x^3-Dx and P*=(57/8-7sqrt(2)/2,-165/8+417sqrt(2)/32), 2E(K)=Z P*, P* has infinite order and E(K)_tors=E[2](K).
entries.application_scope: Every doubled half-point in the new rational source has a unique nonzero integer index; equality of indices follows from infinite order.
entries.comparison_status: Exact inherited generator block and exact inherited unit transport.

entries.statement: The sparse affine chart with f=1/x and z=-x/y represents precisely nonzero points of 2E(K). For Q=[4]P* as subtraction reference, x(U)=x(Q) iff U=+/-Q; the source keeps this difference denominator invertible.
entries.application_scope: The new source uses explicit half-points and duplication, then differences from [4]P* and [4 n_i]P*. It does not consume the selected V4 doubled/private conic chart.
entries.comparison_status: Inherited chart scope checked; new quotient-domain proof supplies the changed chart.

entries.statement: For every nonzero integer n, absolute logarithmic Weil height h(x([n]P*)) >= n^2-6.
entries.application_scope: Used for all nonzero integer root labels, with the normalized P* exactly as in the source; h is logarithmic height, not multiplicative height.

entries.statement: For rational a outside {0,1,2401,-343/32}, h(a)<=H_* M_5(a)^24. M_5 uses normalized positive odd valuations outside primes <=76176 of the four finite contacts and infinity. H_*=2(4608^165888+6^100)(product_{p<=76176}p)^24+128 and log_2 H_*<4783227.
entries.application_scope: The new source uses this original exponent-24 bound. It does not substitute the V4 exponent-19 constant or its 2093966 bound. Nine scales transfer finite contacts and infinity through r and 1/(r-delta).
entries.comparison_status: Entire 875-line proof block is exact inherited text.

entries.statement: For b!=0, B=17b and rational t,U,e,p,q,s,h: U(1+bt^2)=b(1-bt^2), p^2=B(1-e)(1+3e), h=e(B-U^2), Bq^2=(s^2-Bh)(s^2+3Bh). Existence excludes negative odd valuations of b outside {2,3,17}; converse holds for positive b with square reduced denominator and square in Q_2,Q_3,Q_17.
entries.application_scope: Scalar certificate retains preparation. Coordinate certificates specialize t=0,U=b, using the separate preparation-zero bridge. Degenerate e,h,s,U are permitted by soundness; no unjustified extra guard is introduced.
entries.comparison_status: Entire statement, obstruction, simultaneous realization and completeness block exact inherited text.

entries.statement: For every positive squarefree ell congruent 11 mod12 and E_ell:y^2=x(x-ell)(x+3ell), corank_Z2 Sel_{2^infinity}(E_ell/Q)=1 implies analytic order at s=1 equals1.
entries.application_scope: This non-CM rational family is used in the existing simultaneous-realization proof, not the CM normalized index curve. Its full inherited proof-status qualifications remain in force.
entries.comparison_status: Statement exact inherited text; this interface audit does not independently reprove the long restricted-converse chain.

entries.statement: For positive squarefree mu,theta with disjoint support avoiding2,3, mu=17 mod24, theta=1 mod24 and mutual local squareness at their supporting primes, some positive squarefree n prime to6theta gives nonzero rational points in squareclass mu on E_n and E_(n theta). Theta=1 is allowed.
entries.application_scope: This is the exact arithmetic existence input for the preparation-zero bridge; its squareclass, support, positivity and congruence assumptions are explicitly proved there.

entries.statement: The t=0 specialization with four witnesses e,p,q,s is complete when b>0 has square denominator, is locally square at2,3,17, b<17 and v_2(b)>=3,v_3(b)>=1,v_17(b)>=2. Its one-sided obstruction has no added nonzero witness assumptions.
entries.application_scope: All nine coordinate poles; all listed small-prime and archimedean conditions are constructed before completion.
entries.comparison_status: New complete proof; not an invocation of arbitrary-preparation completeness.

entries.statement: The signed squarefree products of2,3,5,7,11,13,17 span the local squareclasses at Q_2,Q_3,Q_17 and the real sign. Deep successive choices of J0 and S make the norm tree a unit at every prime dividing c r.
entries.application_scope: Integral X gives nonzero integer r of absolute value>1. Choose c first, h0 second, a third; final h lies in a congruence class preserving all finite scalar conditions.
entries.comparison_status: Exact finite-correction block plus full changed-order continuity argument in new bridge.

entries.statement: For beta=X^2+2, r=beta(beta-1)(beta-2401)(32beta+343)(2beta-1), six component tests f(H),f(S),z(S)/z(H) with orders1,1,1,1,32,32 and the specified seven-leaf N_r norm tree imply M_5(beta)^32 divides a and h(beta)<=H_*|a|^(3/4).
entries.application_scope: The original scalar48 bound h(beta)<=H_*sqrt(|a|) is not applicable after changing the order. New proof supplies both directions, successive choices and stability under arbitrary later modulus enlargement.
entries.comparison_status: New changed-order proof; exact old norm argument and original height theorem are identified inputs.

entries.statement: For integer s,t,z with |s|>=7 and z!=0, t^2-s(s-2)tz+(s-2)^2z^2=1 implies |t|>exp(|s|-3). For every integer s with |s|>=7 a positive integral pair t,z exists.
entries.application_scope: Applies with (s,t,z)=(a,t,b), where a is the anchored scalar label. The new source tests the exact polynomial with constant term -1 directly; it does not divide by s(s-2) or use the V4 normalized beta-only variant.

entries.statement: At3, P* reduces to order2 and v_3(z(2P*))=1. For nonzero even n, v_3(f(nP*))=2+2v_3(n); at2 both rational f coefficients are integral on nonzero even multiples.
entries.application_scope: The new quaternion three-witness certificate with C=3^(2^26) therefore selects exactly nonzero n in2*3^(2^25-1) Z and yields |n|>(21H_*)^(13/2)>(20H_*)^4.
entries.comparison_status: Exact local calculation inherited; new exponent and three-witness formula are proved in new section.

entries.statement: A quadratic field embeds in quaternion algebra (2,3)_Q iff it is a field at its ramified places2,3; pure trace-zero square represents the corresponding ternary form.
entries.application_scope: Applied to 1-2/(3t^2), which is nonzero. Rational-square cases are separately excluded using division. Local squareclasses are explicitly computed; t=0 has explicit witness.
entries.comparison_status: Published input: Voight Proposition14.6.7, not a consequence of the finite coefficient checks.

entries.statement: For rational prime p>76176 and either unramified completion of K, reciprocal logarithm truncations at e in{16,52,64} have the indicated error for formal points; denominator valuation is exactly -v(z) and truncation is globally nonzero for nonzero reciprocal f.
entries.application_scope: Both split and inert places are permitted in soundness. Completeness uses split places supplied by the Gaussian prime theorem. Formal logarithm comparison has exactly the integer index ratios.
entries.comparison_status: V4 extends truncation range to10..64 but still states split scope. New unramified proof closes that scope, rather than silently using the split statement.

entries.statement: For nonzero f in K and integer J>=2, the finite reciprocal polynomial used in the denominator is nonzero, with proof from signs/conjugates; the corollary covers10<=e<=64.
entries.application_scope: The shared formal denominator is defined even at nonformal global points. This is needed when specifying the source before selecting contact primes.
entries.comparison_status: Main statement and proof exact inherited text; only the listed truncation range is enlarged in V4.

entries.statement: The closure G of the integer orbit in the two real elliptic groups is a compact abelian Lie group whose identity torus surjects onto both identity circles. Every nonconstant arithmetic progression meets a fixed compact pole-free region with one uniform bound chosen before its modulus.
entries.application_scope: The sixteen comparison functions and their direct Lucas polynomial satisfy the finite-pole hypothesis. This removes the circularity of choosing archimedean bounds only after the Sun primes and CRT modulus.
entries.comparison_status: New full compact-group proof; does not assert density in the whole product if the orbit closure is smaller.

entries.statement: Simultaneous prime values of the finite distinct forms u-c_j w^2 admit arbitrary finite exclusions/dilation, pi=9 mod16, pi=1+3i mod7, pi=i modM, and gcd(N(pi_p-1),N(pi_q+1))=4 for every pair p,q.
entries.application_scope: The inherited same-prime gcd theorem does not supply cross-prime compatibility. New Sun proof is required. It supplies gcds4,64,4 for the final three congruences after excluding odd prime factors of L.
entries.comparison_status: New prime theorem supplied by separate section/independent audit. Gaussian norms must explicitly be identified with the two curve reduction orders.
entries.publication_status: The new appendix explicitly consumes Frei-Tinkova arXiv version3 Theorem1.4, author-listed as accepted by Mathematika; a final published version has not been verified. This audit checks the new theorem statement against its application, not the entire new prime proof.

entries.statement: At p=1 mod8 and p=3 mod7 the conjugate values of d=3-sqrt(2) have product7 nonsquare, so the two curves are opposite quadratic twists of y^2=x^3-x. Frobenius belongs to Z[i]; full2-torsion makes its real coordinate odd. The two cardinalities are exactly the unordered pair N(pi-1),N(pi+1).
entries.application_scope: Orient the two places by v_2 of their orders:6 for minus,2 for plus. This ties the Gaussian theorem to the normalized index curve; no arbitrary choice of primary generator is silently made.
entries.comparison_status: Existing explicit CM derivation at current8348..8362 applies unchanged after checking the prescribed prime congruences. New explicit bridge lemma identifies Gaussian associates by parity.

entries.statement: The original height and restricted-converse proofs use the published arithmetic inputs with the five stated qualifications retained verbatim in substance.
entries.application_scope: This review compares and checks consumption of those statements; it does not claim a fresh proof of the complete restricted-converse, modularity, integral-moduli or prime-distribution literature.
entries.comparison_status: Declared trust boundary. Separate original source audits remain applicable; finite polynomial replay does not certify these inputs.
